yellow.$description: Amber ramp (Radix amber) — warm yellow for warning states. Named 'yellow' for backward compat; values sourced from Radix amber scale.

copper.$description: Bronze ramp (Radix bronze) — warm brown for AI/special states. Named 'copper' for backward compat; values sourced from Radix bronze scale.

gray-dark.$description: Radix dark gray scale — for dark mode surfaces, text, and borders.

grass-dark.$description: Radix dark grass scale — for primary (grass) in dark mode.

lime-dark.$description: Radix dark lime scale — for success (lime) in dark mode.

yellow-dark.$description: Radix dark amber scale — for warning in dark mode. Named 'yellow-dark' to match the light 'yellow' ramp.

blue-dark.$description: Radix dark blue scale — for info status and primary (if using blue) in dark mode.

green-dark.$description: Radix dark green scale — for green-based status in dark mode.

red-dark.$description: Radix dark red scale — for danger in dark mode.
